messages.subject: Still troubled over proper install
parts:

intermittent errors. For example a simple job completes but with
occasional errors in the middle.

library(Rhipe)
rhinit()
rhoptions(runner = "R CMD /ln/cluster_node_image/R/lib64/R/library/
Rhipe/libs/imperious.so --slave --silent --vanilla --max-ppsize=100000
--max-nsize=1G")

a = list()
a$ofolder = "/jrounds/tmp/lapply"
a$inout = c("lapply", "sequence")
a$jobname = a$ofolder
a$N = 1000

a$map = expression({
for(i in seq_along(map.values)){
rhcollect(1,runif(1000))
}

})


mr = do.call("rhmr",a)
ex = rhex(mr)

odata = rhread(a$ofolder, type="sequence")

I think the much better way is to follow the instructions on running rhipe on nodes without r installed.

Debugging is easier since you can put messages in the script file. This will alleviate much grief!
